rules.description: Detects requirement for proprietary integration modules or closed APIs without or equivalent functional specifications.
rules.remediation_template: Pursuant to Article 42(4) of Directive 2014/24/EU, technical specifications shall not refer to a specific make or source unless accompanied by the words or equivalent. Please confirm that standard open REST API integrations meeting equivalent functional requirements are permissible.

rules.description: Flags structural contradiction where the Technical Specification allows COTS solutions, while the Draft Contract mandates full unencrypted source code transfer.
rules.remediation_template: The Technical Specification permits pre-existing/COTS software modules, whereas the Draft Contract mandates unconditional transfer of full source code. Please clarify the IP clause so that pre-existing background IP is licensed appropriately, while source-code transfer applies strictly to bespoke custom-developed integration layers.

rules.description: Identifies mandatory specialist certifications that have been officially retired by the vendor.
rules.remediation_template: The qualification requirements reference a vendor certification that is deprecated or proprietary without an equivalent functional benchmark. In accordance with Article 58(1) of Directive 2014/24/EU, please confirm that current industry-standard equivalents will be accepted.
